{
  "name": "@paperclipai/deploy-cloudflare",
  "version": "0.1.0",
  "private": true,
  "type": "module",
  "main": "./src/boot.ts",
  "scripts": {
    "build": "node build-worker.mjs",
    "dev": "node build-worker.mjs && wrangler dev --no-bundle --local",
    "deploy": "node build-worker.mjs && wrangler deploy --no-bundle"
  },
  "dependencies": {
    "@paperclipai/db": "workspace:*",
    "@paperclipai/shared": "workspace:*",
    "drizzle-orm": "^0.38.4",
    "hono": "^4.0.0",
    "postgres": "^3.4.5"
  },
  "devDependencies": {
    "@cloudflare/workers-types": "^4.0.0",
    "@types/express": "^5.0.0",
    "@types/node": "^25.6.0",
    "express": "^5.1.0",
    "typescript": "^5.0.0",
    "wrangler": "^4.87.0"
  }
}
